issues.current_text: A TSMC está sobrecarregada em 3nm e esgotada em 2nm até 2028, empurrando Nvidia e Tesla para a Samsung
issues.previous_text: TSMC esgotou a produção de chips de 2nm até 2028 — Nvidia, AMD, Qualcomm e Apple reservaram tudo.
issues.suggestion: The TSMC 2nm sold-out-until-2028 fact was the headline of yesterday's edition. The 3nm overload is new — lead with that and drop or reduce the 2nm mention to a brief callback ('além da já conhecida escassez em 2nm'). Otherwise readers see the same stat two days in a row.

issues.current_text: empurrando Nvidia e Tesla para a Samsung, que assinou MoU com a AMD para HBM4
issues.previous_text: Samsung preenche a brecha: a taxa de aproveitamento do processo de 2nm atingiu 60%, com pedidos confirmados da Tesla e Apple; AMD e Meta estão auditando presencialmente as linhas de produção de memória HBM4.
issues.suggestion: Samsung-as-TSMC-alternative has run in 3 of the last 4 editions (03-29, 03-31, 04-01). The MoU with AMD is a genuine new development vs. the 03-29 'auditing HBM4 lines' — make the progression explicit ('Após auditorias reportadas na semana passada, Samsung e AMD formalizaram MoU para HBM4') or cut if the angle feels stale.

issues.current_text: Eli Lilly compra a Centessa por até $7,8bi para distúrbios do sono
issues.previous_text: A Eli Lilly assinou um acordo de até $2,75bi com a Insilico Medicine (Hong Kong) — $115M de entrada — para licenciar medicamentos orais descobertos com IA generativa.
issues.suggestion: Two Eli Lilly mega-deals in 3 days. The Centessa acquisition is genuinely different (sleep disorders, not AI-discovered drugs), but readers may notice the pattern. Consider acknowledging continuity: 'Menos de 48h após o acordo de $2,75bi com a Insilico, a Lilly agora compra a Centessa por até $7,8bi — sinalizando uma onda de aquisições.'

issues.current_text: A CoreWeave fechou um empréstimo de $8,5bi lastreado em GPUs — primeiro com grau de investimento — totalizando $28bi em financiamento em 12 meses. Microsoft, Chevron e Engine No. 1 assinaram exclusividade para uma usina a gás de $7bi e 2.500MW no Texas, enquanto a Constellation pediu à FERC para acelerar a reconexão de Three Mile Island
issues.previous_text: A Nebius anunciou um data center de $10bi e 310MW na Finlândia [...] a empresa já tem contratos de mais de $40bi com Microsoft e Meta
issues.suggestion: Every edition in the past 4 days features at least one multi-billion-dollar data center or energy infrastructure deal (03-29: Fermi 5GW, 03-30: Mistral $830M, 03-31: Nebius $10bi, 04-01: CoreWeave $8.5bi + $7bi Texas plant + Three Mile Island). The framing is always 'Company X secures $Ybi for AI infrastructure.' Consider varying the angle — focus on the GPU-backed debt innovation (which is genuinely novel) and compress or cut the energy deals into a single sentence.

issues.current_text: O Brent caiu 3,2% para $103,97 após sinais de abertura do presidente iraniano [...] Trump disse que pode encerrar a campanha em 2-3 semanas
issues.previous_text: O petróleo Brent fechou março em alta de 56% [...] Powell disse em Harvard que o Fed pode 'esperar para ver' [...] Estados do Golfo pedem a Trump que continue a guerra até que o regime iraniano caia
issues.suggestion: Iran-oil-markets has been the closing block in every edition for 4 days with the same structure: geopolitical development → oil price quote → market reaction. Today there's a genuine shift (de-escalation signals, Brent dropping, best day since spring) — lead with the tonal change rather than repeating the Iran→oil→markets chain. Frame as a break from the pattern the reader has been seeing all week.

issues.current_text: Exportações de chips da Coreia do Sul bateram recorde de $32,84bi em março (+151% YoY)
issues.previous_text: A receita da chinesa Yuanjie Semiconductor [...] cresceu 138% em 2025
issues.suggestion: Minor: consecutive editions use large YoY percentage growth figures for Asian chip stories. Not a direct repeat but contributes to a sameness feeling. If possible, contextualize the Korean number differently — e.g., what the $32.84bi means in absolute terms vs previous record, rather than leading with percentage.

issues.current_text: a Saronic levantou $1,75bi a $9,25bi de valuation
issues.previous_text: a sul-coreana Rebellions levantou $400M [...] avaliada em $2,34bi / a londrina Fractile negocia $200M para entrar no clube dos unicórnios
issues.suggestion: 'Levantou $X a $Y de valuation' appears in nearly every edition as a story unit. Consider varying the verb (captou, garantiu, fechou rodada de) or restructuring: lead with what the company does and why it matters, with the funding as supporting detail rather than the headline.

issues.current_text: A Anthropic vazou acidentalmente o código-fonte do Claude Code via npm — 512 mil linhas em ~1.900 arquivos
issues.previous_text: A Anthropic confirmou que as assinaturas pagas do Claude mais que dobraram desde janeiro, com ARR chegando a $19bi em março
issues.suggestion: Anthropic featured prominently in 03-29 (ARR, paid subscriptions doubling) and now in 04-01 (source code leak). These are genuinely different stories, but two high-profile Anthropic appearances in 4 days. No action needed if both are newsworthy — just flag for awareness.

summary: Moderate repetition. TSMC 2nm capacity and Samsung-as-alternative are the most flagrant repeats (same facts from yesterday). Eli Lilly deals, data center infrastructure framing, and Iran-oil-markets closing block all recur structurally. Recommend reframing TSMC/Samsung with explicit callbacks and varying the data center and geopolitics narrative angles.
